system.name: vpsych
system.description: Therapist-training platform: AI standardized patients, bilingual EN/AR sessions, admin-only performance reports

repository.name: alhazayed/vpsych
repository.storage: Supabase (DB primary; no dedicated app Storage buckets inventoried as primary)
repository.monitoring: In-app ops/CIDP dashboards; Sentry not wired; Vercel insights hosts allowed in CSP

features.name: Virtual patient avatar catalog
features.notes: Seeded avatars; no in-app create UI

features.name: PDF generation
features.notes: No PDF generator found in app dependencies

functions.methodology: All export function/const-arrow and Route Handler methods under src/. Meaningful private helpers documented in Markdown. Full per-param schemas for every export are impractical at 900+; JSON lists name/file/line/domain; MD expands load-bearing APIs.

policy_names: Admins can read security audit events
Authenticated can read active voice profiles
Class memberships self or manager read
Institution managers can view tenant sessions
Institutional feedback select own or admin
Therapists can insert messages on own sessions
Therapists can insert user messages on own sessions
Users can update own display name

integrations.failure: Falls back to gateway then persona_fallback/heuristic
TTS errors surfaced; browser speak fallback exists

virtualPatients.lifecycle: seed/DB insert → personalities/clinical_core jsonb → voice assign → is_active → start session → createCaseForSession → clinical_snapshot freeze → resolveAvatar → session → assessment
difficulty_creating_additional: No admin Create Avatar page/API for full avatar mint
Avatar v2 schema requires clinical_core + personalities locales + voice casting
Native EN and AR personalities must be authored independently (never translated)

flags.NEXT_PUBLIC_THERAPY_ROOM_MODE: immersive room vs classic toggle on start

therapyRoom.pipeline: mic → STT → message API → patient agent → TTS → audio
therapyRoom.arabic: locale ar; separate voice IDs; native ar-JO personality

competencyEngine.path: assessSession → runEducationAfterAssessment → runAceAfterAssessment → mapRubric/EMA → generateLearningPlan → CGE ace-bridge

suspicious_ui.identical_strengths_focus: LearnerDashboard sorts same radar for top and weak — identical when flat
suspicious_ui.utterance_zeros: supervisor counters from transcript heuristics; short/fallback sessions yield 0

findings.title: Session end requires REPORT_WRITE_KEY or SERVICE_ROLE else 500
ACE/CGE baseline score 70 produces flat identical dashboards
estimated_sessions_to_threshold floored at 1 even when gap=0
No in-app Virtual Patient create/publish workflow
Adaptive case shown as raw JSON in learner UI
Dual Therapy Room feature flags confuse ops
Enterprise LMS schema largely unused by app .from()
Upstash optional — rate limits not horizontal without Redis

limitations: Competency scores not validated for high-stakes use
Therapists cannot read full session_reports (by design)
Therapy Room / clinic off by default
Avatar catalog limited; no create UI
Enterprise multi-tenant product incomplete despite schema
No PDF export in application dependencies
No product cron; retention RPC unscheduled
Assessment reliability harness not on main
Heuristic/persona fallbacks when AI keys missing

audit_completeness.notes: Full forensic INPUT/OUTPUT cards provided for load-bearing functions in Markdown; JSON holds mechanical export index for all exports.
